summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of NIDP Console (VM-based query_api at 34.47.191.39:8090). All 15 backend pytest cases pass and the React /nidp console renders all 6 tabs with live VM data. Auth, diag, jobs, runs, logs, calendar, execute, catalog, and quality endpoints all return 200 with correct VM-routed payloads.
critical_code_review_comments: Problem statement said the route is /admin/nidp; actual SPA route is /nidp (defined in App.js, linked from UserProfileDropdown and AdminView). Not a bug — just a docs/naming mismatch worth aligning.

Diagnostics response from /api/admin/nidp/diag nests reachable/auth_ok/db_latency_ms inside nidp_query_api object and NIDP_QUERY_API_URL inside env object. Problem statement implied a flat shape; consider documenting the actual schema or flattening top-level convenience keys.

Quality endpoints return errors as a per-key dict ({'quality': null, 'certified': null, ...}) rather than a single null/array. Caller code should treat any-falsy-value as ok. Considered correct behavior, just non-obvious.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 6 tabs render, no console errors, all /api/admin/nidp/* calls return 200

seed_data_creation: None — endpoints already returning real VM TimescaleDB data; amfi_circulars execute call spawned a real run on the VM (idempotent and safe).
context_for_next_testing_agent: NIDP Console URL is /nidp (NOT /admin/nidp). Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_nidp_admin_vm_iteration55.py — reuse for regressions. The diag response nests health under nidp_query_api.health.db_latency_ms and env.NIDP_QUERY_API_URL. Quality summary 'errors' field is a dict of per-source nulls (not a single null). Frontend successfully calls VM-backed endpoints; Grafana link data-testid='admin-nidp-grafana-link' resolves to http://34.47.191.39:3000/d/nidp-job-health/nidp-job-health.
